name: Nymeria
tagline: 300 h of in-the-wild daily motion: 1,200 sequences, 264 participants, 50 locations, 240 Hz XSens body mocap and 310.5K narration sentences.

annotations.format: CSV (narration, MPS trajectories, gaze), NPZ (XSens / Momentum body), JSON (metadata), VRS (sensors)
annotations.coverageNote: All 1,200 sequences have body motion; narration coverage per card: motion narration 39 h, atomic actions 207 h, activity summaries 196 h.

narrations.note: 3 tiers: motion narration (<5 s), atomic action, activity summary (~30 s)

action_labels.note: Atomic-action sentences per ~5 s clip; 20 scripted scenarios

hand_pose.note: Wrist trajectories only (miniAria wristbands); no finger joints

body_pose.note: XSens 240 Hz kinematics retargeted to Momentum; NymeriaPlus adds MHR + SMPL

gaze.note: MPS general + personalized eye gaze CSVs (10.8M gaze points)

camera_pose.note: MPS SLAM closed/open-loop trajectories for head, wrists, observer

scene_3d.note: MPS semi-dense point clouds per recording
